warnings.description: Wind warning for sea areas: From the night between Sunday and Monday to the night between Monday and Tuesday, probability for north to northeast gale-force winds is 70%.
Wave height warning: Very rough waves occur from the evening on. Significant wave height exceeds 4 meters.
Wind warning for sea areas: North to northeast severe gale 21 m/s from the early morning on.

warnings.headline: Yellow Gale 18-24 m/s Sea of Aaland
warnings.description:
North 14-17 m/s. Sunday morning 15-20 m/s. Sunday evening 14-17 m/s.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Sea of Aaland
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute

warnings.headline: Yellow Snow and wind Parts of eastern Svealand
warnings.description: From night to Sunday snowfall combined with wind that may cause traffic difficulties.; What happens?: From night to Sunday, snowfall is expected, which can be heavy at times. This is combined with a fresh northerly wind. The snowfall is expected to temporarily subside during Sunday afternoon and evening, and then start up again during the night to Monday. Until Monday afternoon, 5-15 cm of fresh snow is expected. Most of the snow is expected in the northern part. Along the coast, it will probably be mostly rain.
